She wants a radical reform of the national curriculum in England to reduce “desktop” working in favour of verbal fluency and practical skills . This will take courage. For decades, education’s senior leaders have been ramming easily forgotten “subjects”, such as maths and French, into children’s brains so they can be judged and measured in league tables.
